strategy.primary: Wheels and draw punishment: force opponents to draw many cards (wheels, Peer into the Abyss, Winds of Change) with Nekusar and overlapping pingers out, so each draw deals damage.
strategy.secondary: Multiply Nekusar's Wizard triggers (Harmonic Prodigy, Wizard's Staff, Krang), use Ghyrson for exact-1 damage events, and loop Underworld Breach + Wheel of Fortune + Jeska's Will.

commander_oracle_snapshots.name: Nekusar, the Mindrazer
commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text:
At the beginning of each player's draw step, that player draws an additional card.
Whenever an opponent draws a card, Nekusar deals 1 damage to that player.

identity.why: Extra draws plus a damage trigger.
Best wheel, and the Breach loop.
